english: A ticket glows.
The flecks make a door.
Gail sees the museum.
The labels fly away.
This label is wrong.
Gail looks closely.
One is rough.
This is wood.
Here is a fossil.
A foot made this mark.
These pictures are close.
The statue stands here.
Gail is not sure.
Open the drawer.
This drawing fits.
The labels go back.
The room is clear.
Gail tells the curator.
The ticket glows again.
Gail is home.
chinese: 票券發光了。
紙屑做出一道門。
瑜瑜看見博物館。
標籤飛走了。
這張標籤錯了。
瑜瑜仔細看。
這個很粗糙。
這是木頭。
這是化石。
這是腳印。
兩張圖很像。
雕像站在這裡。
瑜瑜還不確定。
打開抽屜。
這張圖相符。
標籤回去了。
展廳清楚了。
瑜瑜告訴管理員。
票券又發光了。
瑜瑜回家了。

english: A little museum ticket glows in Gail's room. Colored flecks drift from it.
The colored flecks open a doorway. Gail sees a museum beyond it.
Gail sees fossils, statues, and picture labels. A curator waves hello.
A magical breeze lifts the picture labels. They land under the wrong exhibits.
A fossil has a statue label. The curator asks Gail to help.
Gail does not move every label at once. She looks at one object first.
Gail feels a safe sample. One surface is rough and another is smooth.
Gail groups a wooden frame and a metal tool. They belong in different groups.
Gail spots a spiral in a fossil. A picture card shows the same spiral.
Gail finds a footprint pressed into stone. It is not the same as a loose bone.
Two cards look similar. Gail compares the shape inside each frame.
Gail finds a statue with a square base. Its picture card shows the same base.
One object does not fit any card. Gail sets it aside to ask about it.
The curator opens a record drawer. Old picture cards are inside.
Gail finds a drawing of the round object. The curator checks it too.
Gail and the curator return the checked picture labels to the right displays.
The museum display is clear again. Visitors can see what each object is.
Gail explains how she used shape and material. The curator thanks her.
The ticket lifts from Gail's hand. Colored flecks show her the way home.
Gail keeps the ticket by her bed. She remembers to ask when she is unsure.
chinese: 小小的博物館票券在瑜瑜房裡發光。彩色紙屑飄出來。
彩色紙屑打開一道門。瑜瑜看見博物館。
瑜瑜看見化石、雕像和圖像標籤。管理員揮手。
魔法風捲起圖像標籤，它們落在錯誤展品下。
化石旁有雕像標籤。管理員請瑜瑜幫忙。
瑜瑜沒有一下移動所有標籤。她先看一件物品。
瑜瑜摸安全樣本。一種表面粗糙，另一種光滑。
瑜瑜把木框與金屬工具分組。它們屬於不同組。
瑜瑜看見化石的螺旋紋，一張圖卡也有同樣圖案。
瑜瑜找到留在石頭上的腳印。它和骨頭不同。
兩張卡片看起來相近。瑜瑜比較其中的形狀。
瑜瑜找到有方形底座的雕像。圖卡也畫了同樣底座。
一件物品對不上任何圖卡。瑜瑜先放著，再詢問。
管理員打開紀錄抽屜，裡面有舊圖卡。
瑜瑜找到未知物的圖。管理員也核對。
瑜瑜和管理員把核對過的標籤放回正確展品旁。
博物館展覽又清楚了。訪客能看懂每件物品。
瑜瑜說明如何看形狀和材質。管理員謝謝她。
票券從瑜瑜手中升起。彩色紙屑帶她回家。
瑜瑜把票券放在床邊。她記得不確定時要提問。

english: A little museum ticket rises beside Gail in her familiar bedroom. Colored flecks lift from its edge and gather near the window.
Only after the ticket begins to glow do its paper flecks form a doorway. Gail sees a warm museum gallery on the other side.
Gail enters a gallery filled with fossils, statues, and other exhibits. The friendly curator is preparing a new display.
A brief magical breeze lifts the picture labels from their places. When they land, the labels no longer match the exhibits above them.
A fossil now has the picture label for a statue, while a smooth wooden object has a fossil label. The curator asks Gail to help sort them.
Gail resists swapping labels at random. She and the curator inspect one exhibit before deciding which picture belongs beside it.
The curator offers safe touch samples. Gail compares a rough stone surface with a smooth carved surface and notices they are not the same material.
Gail helps group a wooden frame with other wooden objects and a small metal tool with metal ones. Each material category narrows the possible labels.
Gail inspects a fossil with a clear spiral shape. One picture card shows the same shape, but she leaves it beside the exhibit until the curator checks it.
Nearby, Gail finds a footprint preserved in stone. Although both exhibits come from long ago, a footprint is a trace, not a loose bone.
Two picture cards share the same color, but one shows the outline of a foot and the other a bone. Gail compares shapes rather than colors alone.
The small statue stands on a square base that appears on one picture card. Gail pairs them, then asks the curator to confirm the match.
A round object fits none of the remaining pictures. Gail does not invent an answer; she keeps its place open and asks the curator what they can check.
The curator opens a drawer of original exhibit records. Each record includes a simple drawing of an object and where it was displayed.
Gail finds a drawing whose handle and round top match the unknown object. The curator checks both details before naming it.
Together they return only the confirmed picture labels to their exhibits. The unknown object's label is added after its record has been checked.
With each label beside the right exhibit, the gallery is easy to explore again. Visitors can compare the fossil, statue, and materials without confusion.
Gail tells the curator how shape, material, and the original records helped identify the objects. The curator thanks her for checking rather than guessing.
After they say goodbye, the museum ticket glows again. Its colored flecks gather into a quiet doorway back to Gail's room.
Back in her familiar bedroom, Gail places the ticket beside her bed. She remembers that an unanswered question can stay open until she finds good evidence.
chinese: 一張小小的博物館票券在瑜瑜熟悉的臥室裡升起。彩色紙屑從票邊飄出，在窗邊聚集。
票券先發光，彩色紙屑才組成一道門。瑜瑜從門的另一端看見溫暖的博物館展廳。
瑜瑜走進擺滿化石、雕像與其他展品的展廳。親切的管理員正在準備新展覽。
一陣短短的魔法風把圖像標籤吹離原位。它們落下時，已和上方展品對不上了。
化石旁貼著雕像圖卡，光滑的木製品旁卻貼著化石圖卡。管理員請瑜瑜幫忙整理。
瑜瑜沒有隨意交換標籤。她和管理員先仔細觀察一件展品，再決定哪張圖該放在旁邊。
管理員提供可安全觸摸的樣本。瑜瑜比較粗糙石面與光滑雕刻面，發現兩者材質不同。
瑜瑜把木框放在其他木製品旁，把小金屬工具放在金屬品旁。每個材質類別都縮小了標籤的可能範圍。
瑜瑜觀察一件有清楚螺旋紋的化石。一張圖卡畫著相同形狀，但她先放在展品旁，等管理員核對。
附近有一個保存在石頭裡的腳印。雖然兩件展品都很古老，腳印是痕跡，不是一塊散落的骨頭。
兩張圖卡顏色相同，一張畫腳掌輪廓，另一張畫骨頭。瑜瑜比較形狀，沒有只憑顏色判斷。
小雕像立在方形底座上，其中一張圖卡也畫了同樣底座。瑜瑜先配對，再請管理員確認。
一件圓形物品和剩下的圖卡都不相符。瑜瑜沒有編出答案，而是保留空位，問管理員還能查什麼。
管理員打開存放原始展品紀錄的抽屜。每張紀錄都有物品簡圖與原先展示位置。
瑜瑜找到一張畫，畫上的把手和圓頂都與未知物相符。管理員核對兩處細節後，才說出物品名稱。
兩人只把確認過的圖像標籤放回展品旁。未知物的紀錄查清楚後，才補上它的標籤。
每張標籤都回到正確展品旁，展廳又容易參觀了。訪客能清楚比較化石、雕像與各種材質。
瑜瑜告訴管理員，她如何用形狀、材質與原始紀錄辨認物品。管理員謝謝她先查證、沒有亂猜。
兩人道別後，博物館票券再次發光。彩色紙屑聚成一道安靜的門，通往瑜瑜的房間。
回到熟悉臥室，瑜瑜把票券放在床邊。她記得，沒有答案的問題可以先保留，找到可靠線索再回答。
